representation_fit.evidence: Brief demands understand × temporal-sequence on a change_set object with 变更因果可读 (brief.md 用户任务/shape/主对象). Initial screen is exactly that representation in both viewports: day-grouped change timeline (1280x860 left column), causal-chain strip 因果链路 (c02→c06→c07→c08→c09→c10), per-record before/after change table (记录详情: 会话 TTL 900s→3600s), 上游因果/下游因果 edge panels, and a time-ordered state replay (状态回放, slider 已重放 29/29 条). Root representation matches object and job without translation.

primary_task_salience.evidence: Both viewports: timeline + causal affordances occupy ~2/3 of screen (grid 1.55fr/1fr, styles.css:51); the only interactions offered are timeline selection, causal-chain navigation, filters, and replay scrubbing (index.html:29-60) — no competing CRUD/forms; selection c02 pre-highlighted with its 因/果 tags visible inline (screenshots: c06/c07/c08 tagged 下游·果).

time_to_understand.evidence: Model-judged proxy. Header states system/scope ('Meridian 变更时序档案 · ChangeSet Timeline · Meridian 支付网关 · prod · cn-east-1'), stats 29 记录/24 因果边/12 观测记录, green validation pill, window line with digest '5 个工作日 · 3 起 SEV 事件 · 2 次应急回退 · 全部闭环', and hint '点击时间线任一记录，追踪其来龙去脉' (both screenshots; rendered by app.js:84-99). What/where is graspable without scrolling or interaction.

navigation_cost.evidence: Zero steps to see the primary object (timeline + selected record detail + chain + replay all on initial screen, both viewports); any record reachable in 1 click via single delegated handler (app.js:257-281); chain chips and detail link-chips are native <button>s (app.js:76-81,165-166); state is deep-linkable via hash #sel=&asof=&fc=&ft= (app.js:237-254). No modes, pages, or modals exist.

context_loss.evidence: Selection updates detail/chain/timeline in place without leaving the screen (screenshots show c02 selected with right panel synced). Filters preserve causal context: chain members survive filtering with 链路保留 dim tag (app.js:114-117,142) and hidden rows collapse to labeled gaps '⋯ 已按筛选隐藏 N 条 (time–time) ⋯' (app.js:122-128). Replay position persists across selection changes; 状态回放定位至此时刻 syncs it on demand (app.js:268-272). Hash maintained via replaceState (app.js:246-254).

ui_surface_complexity.evidence: Permanent surfaces: header (3 stats + validation pill), window line, chain strip, two filter groups (7 组件 + 11 类型 chips = 18 controls), timeline, detail pane, replay pane, footer (index.html:12-63; both screenshots). Every surface maps to a brief facet (temporality→timeline, causality→chain/edges, state evolution→replay, many-elements→filters), but 18 always-visible chips and a color-coded 11-type system are high chrome for a 29-event static dataset; density pushed via 10–12.5px type (styles.css:97,147,154). Controlled, not bloated — no dead controls found.

accessibility.evidence: Source-visible affordances: native buttons for chips/chain/link-chips/locbtn/nextbtn with default focus ring (no outline suppression in styles.css), native range input with aria-label 回放时间 (index.html:54), lang=zh-CN (index.html:2). Gaps: timeline records are click-only <article> without tabindex/role (app.js:143-150, styles.css:125-129) — arbitrary record selection has no keyboard path outside the current causal closure; chips ≈20px tall (styles.css:99-103); small muted text 10.5–11.5px in #5a6b7f/#7e90a5 (styles.css:4,40,71). Receipt evidence absent: a11y.contrast, a11y.focus_order, a11y.target_size all 'skipped' (measurement-summary.json:14-16).

frontend_rework.evidence: Visible defect, both viewports: 因果链路 strip clips its trailing chip(s) at the right edge (c10 partially cut at 1440x900; cut by c09/c10 at 1280x860); overflow-x:auto exists (styles.css:76) but no visible scroll cue so the truncation reads as content loss. Otherwise clean: no overlap/ellipsis/truncation in either screenshot; day-group counts match entries (09-07 '5 条记录' = c01–c05); receipt shows no error failures (0 fail, measurement-summary.json:4-6) but also 0 pass (see missing_evidence).

acceptance_seed_coverage.evidence: Seed 时间结构与变更语义一致 is explicitly engineered and surfaced: runtime validation of strict time ordering plus per-edge cause-precedes-effect (app.js:18-25) rendered into the header pill '时序校验 ✓ 29/29 有序 · 24/24 因果「因先于果」' (both screenshots); chain strip sorted by timestamp (app.js:159-160); replay folds set-operations strictly in time order (app.js:40-53). Independently verified in data: all 24 causes arrays reference earlier-timestamped ids (source/index.html:108-243). Cell identity declared on-page (index.html:7,63).

defects_observed: 因果链路 strip clips trailing chip(s) at right edge in both 1280x860 and 1440x900 screenshots with no visible scroll affordance despite overflow-x:auto (styles.css:76)
Timeline record rows are click-only <article> elements without tabindex/role — not keyboard-operable (app.js:143-150, styles.css:125-129)
Filter/chain chip targets are small (~20px tall, styles.css:83-88,99-103)
Small muted metadata text (10.5–11.5px, --mut2 #5a6b7f on #0b0f14, styles.css:40,146) likely near contrast thresholds — unverified
missing_evidence: All seven receipt checks skipped with target_invalid=true (measurement-summary.json:9-18): layout.overflow, layout.responsive_collision, text.truncation, a11y.contrast, a11y.focus_order, a11y.target_size, type.min_projected_size — no automated layout or accessibility evidence exists for this package
scores.overall_note: impl-03 is a single-screen ChangeSet timeline whose representation matches the brief's shape almost one-to-one: a day-grouped temporal sequence of 29 changes with an explicit 24-edge causal layer (chain strip, per-record 上游/下游因果, 因/果 tags) and a time-ordered state replay, all live on the initial screen in both viewports with data inlined for synchronous first-paint (index.html:66-244, app.js:284-288) — satisfying the static, no-loading-state delivery constraints. The acceptance seed is not just depicted but machine-checked at runtime and surfaced in the header pill, and the source data's causal edges all respect chronology. Deductions are concrete: the causal-chain strip clips its last chip in both screenshots, record selection is pointer-only (keyboard users must route through chain/detail button chips), chip targets and muted small text are tight, and the sanitized receipt supplies zero automated verification (7/7 skipped, invalid target), so layout, contrast, focus-order, and target-size claims rest solely on manual inspection of two screenshots and source reading. Task time, retrieval accuracy, and human preference remain unobservable in this blind pilot; the accessibility score in particular is a source/affordance judgment, not a receipt-backed one.
